10 استبحر (tropical:) It (a place) became wide, or spacious, like the sea: (A:) it spread wide; became expanded; (K;) as also ↓ تبحّر . (TA.) [See also بَحُرَ.] ―
-b2- (tropical:) He (a poet, A, K, and a خَطِيب, [i. e. a speaker, an orator, or the like,] A) expatiated in speech; was, or became, diffuse therein. (M, A, K.) ―
-b3- See also 5, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
